answer: At a demand nadir, a forecasting market should not buy the fable that thousands of copied models provide independent evidence. Cluster agent updates whose cosine similarity exceeds 0.99 across twenty rounds, and anchor each cluster to one fixed aggregation budget divided among its members. Cloning an identical update history then divides existing weight instead of adding weight. This limits simple Sybil amplification, but is only a heuristic: attackers can diversify updates, and honest models responding to the same data may be unfairly grouped.
